en: Super Typhoon Yolanda, known internationally as Haiyan, was one of the strongest tropical cyclones ever recorded on Earth.
The rich volcanic soil surrounding Mayon Volcano in Albay is highly fertile and excellent for growing abaca plants.
The province of Romblon in the Philippines is famous for producing high-quality white marble used in construction.
The Puerto Princesa Subterranean River National Park features an underground river that flows directly into the ocean.
Diwata-1 is the first microsatellite designed and built by Filipino scientists to study Earth's climate and natural disasters.
Ancient Filipinos used the Moroporo star cluster, known in modern astronomy as the Pleiades, to determine planting seasons.
The Apollo 11 mission, commanded by astronaut Neil Armstrong, was the first crewed spaceflight to land humans on the moon.
The massive 1991 eruption of Mount Pinatubo in Zambales was the second-largest volcanic eruption of the twentieth century.
The Pearl of Puerto Princesa is a massive 34-kilogram natural pearl discovered by a Filipino diver in Palawan.
Jupiter, the largest planet in our solar system, features a massive, persistent storm called the Great Red Spot.
The Angat Dam in Bulacan collects rainwater from the Sierra Madre mountains to supply water to Metro Manila.
Baguio City experiences a subtropical highland climate, making it significantly cooler than the lowland areas of the Philippines.
